about.label: About
paragraphs: Before code, I built with my hands: a year on construction sites, and months installing sound and lighting systems. That taught me to read a plan and build it exactly, on time.
Then I finished a full stack bootcamp at the top of my cohort, and spent a year as a developer at a cybersecurity startup, building product screens, backend services and the integrations behind them.
